scope: One completed B case startup_front065_tracking_v3b_nominal1 control-trace diagnosis only, not a rerun or gain selection

pose: Estimated state14 pitch[2]/pitchrate[9] at control; grade_before/after actual root pose clocks kept separate. POST body gyro_y is not Euler pitchrate; compute Euler pitchrate=gyro_y*cos(roll)-gyro_z*sin(roll) and label algebraic derivation from saved fields.
actuation: requested_tau6 only. physics/raw actual substep torque or speed not opened, unknown. Already-braking means observed aligned requested wheel torque opposes packet wheel rate and logged soft replacement is false, not a driver receipt.
support: Use saved per-control main mean/min, both-support-all-20-samples and noOther flags. No reconstruction of 2k physics/contact identity from control trace.
joints: Packet joint angles/rates and current published reference only; record max packet-reference error. Fault row may omit reference: last published reference is labeled separately, never relabeled current reference. Private POST true joint error is a distinct logged target comparison.
proxy: Original current-packet-rate rectangle travel .0625*mean(abs(w))*dt; strict >.50 guard unchanged. Encoder absolute-rotation proxy and true XY net displacement are different quantities/epochs; excess is not proof of chassis bound violation, wheel slip, friction, or clipping.
first_persist: Write read counts and bounded EVENTS before narrative. Preserve SOURCE_PREEXEC and failure/source/partial counts if any exception; no automatic raw reopen.
